newsitem.title: UK: British Steel says remains cautious on stg.
newsitem.headline: British Steel says remains cautious on stg.

text.p: British Steel said on Wednesday it continued to be "cautiously optimistic" about its outlook as the sterling strength was seriously impairing the competitiveness of many of its UK customers.
The steel giant's chairman Brian Moffat told shareholders at the annual general meeting demand for its products in the UK was strong, with its mills still working at near full capacity.
"Also encouraging is the continuing improvement in underlying demand and prices in local currency for most steel products across mainland European markets," Moffat said.
Moffat said the recent government changes on tax refunds for pension schemes had not changed its contribution levels although it would consider the implications of the changes in due course.
"Our fund is well financed and conservatively managed and existing pensioners should not be concerned over the security of their pensions," he said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
